name: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians
definition: A ray-marching algorithm implemented on 3D Gaussians to study the impact of approximations like spatial overlap and sorting in 3DGS.
summary: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians is a volumetric rendering method that evaluates the full Gaussian mixture along camera rays to accurately handle primitive overlap and compute the volumetric integral, contrasting with rasterization-based splatting.
